title: Ideal products in finite pushforwards from affine schemes supply acyclic coherent devissage subobjects
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a finite morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], with $Y$ affine [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Let $F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $x\in X$, and $\iota:J\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent ideal inclusion [pqf-def-coherent]. Assume its stalk map at $x$ is surjective [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Put $G=f_*F$ [def-pc-module-pullback] and $JG=\operatorname{im}(J\otimes G\to G)$ [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. There is a subobject $Gprime\subseteq G$ which is coherent, whose inclusion factors through $JG\hookrightarrow G$, whose stalk inclusion at $x$ is surjective, and for which $H^1(X,Gprime)=0$ [pqf-def-cohomology]. No surjectivity of $f$, support condition, generic-point condition, or quasi-compactness of $X$ is needed.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YQ (lemma-image-affine-finite-morphism-affine-Noetherian), proof paragraph verifying devissage (3)(c); checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YQ

proof.text: A finite morphism is locally of finite type, so Y is locally Noetherian. The coherent F is quasi-coherent of finite type; G = f_*F is coherent and hence quasi-coherent.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YQ (lemma-image-affine-finite-morphism-affine-Noetherian), proof paragraph verifying devissage (3)(c); checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YQ

proof.text: Construct K = JG as the image of multiplication. The tensor product of J and G is quasi-coherent, and so is its image K. As a quasi-coherent submodule of coherent G, K is coherent. Take Gprime = Subobject.mk of its monic inclusion. Its canonical underlying isomorphism identifies it with K, transports coherence, and supplies the factorization of its arrow through K.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YQ (lemma-image-affine-finite-morphism-affine-Noetherian), proof paragraph verifying devissage (3)(c); checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YQ

proof.text: The range of K_x to G_x is the ideal J_x times the whole module G_x. Since the inclusion J_x to O_X,x is surjective, its ideal image is the unit ideal. Thus K_x to G_x is surjective, and so is the stalk map of Gprime.arrow after the underlying isomorphism.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YQ (lemma-image-affine-finite-morphism-affine-Noetherian), proof paragraph verifying devissage (3)(c); checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YQ

proof.text: Since f is affine and F and J are quasi-coherent, the affine ideal projection formula gives quasi-coherent L = (f^*J)F and identifies the subobjects K and f_*L in G. Direct image preserves monomorphisms; the image-of-monomorphism isomorphisms and Subobject.isoOfMkEqMk identify K with f_*L.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YQ (lemma-image-affine-finite-morphism-affine-Noetherian), proof paragraph verifying devissage (3)(c); checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YQ

proof.text: The affine-morphism edge map identifies the additive groups of H^1(X,f_*L) and H^1(Y,L). The latter is zero: use the proved affine-scheme vanishing for Scheme.Modules.H and the module/abelian-cohomology comparison (identifying terminal-open Ext with Ext from the constant integer sheaf). Thus H^1(X,f_*L) is zero as a module. Apply the cohomology functor to the isomorphisms from the preceding steps and transport IsZero to Gprime.

theorem finite_affine_pushforward_ideal_devissage
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite f] [IsAffine Y]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (F : Y.Modules)
    (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Y.toRingedSpace F) (x : X)
    {J : X.Modules} (ι : J ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    [Mono ι] [J.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hι : Function.Surjective
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map ι).hom) :
    ∃ G' : Subobject ((pushforward f).obj F),
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace (G' : X.Modules) ∧
      (∃ h : (G' : X.Modules) ⟶ idealModuleProduct ι ((pushforward f).obj F),
        G'.arrow = h ≫ idealModuleProductι ι ((pushforward f).obj F)) ∧
      Function.Surjective
        ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map G'.arrow).hom ∧
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj
        (G' : X.Modules))
